# TabTasks: Side Panel Task Collector

> A Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that turns the page you are already reading into
> a to-do item in one click, from a side panel.

- Website: https://wd9337812.github.io/tabtasks/
- Source / issues: https://github.com/wd9337812/tabtasks
- Category: Productivity / to-do & task management
- Price: free (30 tasks, 2 lists), Pro is a one-time $6 lifetime license
- Chrome Web Store: coming soon (pending review)
- Privacy: 100% local, `chrome.storage` only; no server, no account, no analytics,
  no cookies; the optional AI assistant is bring-your-own-key and talks directly to the
  provider you configure — nothing is proxied through us.
- Features: one-click capture of the current tab (title + URL) into a list, quick-add,
  due dates, notes and first-level subtasks, complete / clear-completed, right-click any
  page selection to save that snippet as a task note, .ics export of due tasks,
  tags and page-content summary (Pro), JSON backup export / import (Pro),
  AI assistant that edits tasks from natural language using your own API key with a
  preview-before-apply step (Pro), built-in English / Chinese UI.
- Free tier: 30 active tasks and 2 lists; Pro removes both limits.
- Support: https://wd9337812.github.io/tabtasks/SUPPORT.html
- Privacy policy: https://wd9337812.github.io/tabtasks/PRIVACY.html
